d: Long, flowing chestnut-brown hair with piecey bangs and a golden headband. Calm, narrow light-blue eyes on a youthful face with a mature expression. A slender build wearing a futuristic black and charcoal grey armored outfit featuring a short skirt, metallic pauldrons, a single armored right leg, and a long yellow scarf flowing behind. Accessories include black fingerless gloves, a black choker, and a long black sword.
